steps.name: 01 Live native controls
steps.goal: Tap Open model controls after the live catalog loads.
steps.done: The native agent controls show GPT-6 Luna.

steps.name: 04 Usage groups
steps.goal: Tap the Model control to open the model list. Wait for usage prices to load.
steps.done: The managed list shows standard and higher usage groups.

steps.name: 05 Highest usage
steps.goal: Inspect the lower part of the model list. Do not select a model yet.
steps.done: The highest usage group and its neutral gauge are visible with Opus 5.5.

steps.name: 06 Select Opus
steps.goal: Tap Opus 5.5 in the model list.
steps.done: The controls return and show Opus 5.5 as the selected model.

steps.name: 07 Reopen model list
steps.goal: Tap the Model Claude Opus 5.5 control to reopen Models.
steps.done: The model search is visible with the unfiltered model list.

steps.name: 07 Search Haiku
steps.goal: Tap the Search 14 models text field and enter the supplied text.
steps.done: Only Haiku 5.5 matches, under standard usage.

steps.name: 08 Select Haiku
steps.goal: Tap the model button labelled Claude Haiku 5.5, with id model-option:omg/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5. This is the row below Standard usage. Do not tap Search or the text field.
steps.done: The controls return and show Haiku 5.5 selected.

steps.name: 09 Reopen after search
steps.goal: Tap Model Claude Haiku 5.5 to reopen the model list.
steps.done: The unfiltered model list is open and the search is empty.

steps.name: 09 Restore default
steps.goal: Tap the model row labelled exactly GPT-6 Luna, with id model-option:omg/openai/gpt-6-luna. Do not tap Search or the text field.
steps.done: The controls return and show GPT-6 Luna selected.

steps.name: 10 Picker evidence
steps.goal: Open Model GPT-6 Luna to show the managed picker again.
steps.done: Standard and higher usage groups are visible in the native picker.
